## Decisions
- Codex CLI: no --system-prompt flag, so SYSTEM_PROMPT prepended to user message
- Codex CLI: --sandbox read-only + --ephemeral + -o tempfile for output
- Qwen CLI: --approval-mode plan (not auto_edit) for safety
- CLI providers share runCli() helper (src/lib/llm/cli-utils.ts)
- Progress keyed by pathHash (not name) to avoid collisions
- LOC primary metric is "Code LOC" (excludes docs + generated)
- GENERATED_DIRS: generated, .prisma, __generated__, .graphql, .openapi, swagger-codegen
- DOC_EXTENSIONS: .md, .mdx, .rst, .txt, .adoc
